title: pseudabutilon scabrum
intro: Pseudabutilon scabrum, commonly known as the "wild mandrake", is a plant species that belongs to the Malvaceae family. It is a shrub-like plant that has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in treating various health conditions. The health benefits of Pseudabutilon scabrum include its potential to reduce inflammation, relieve pain, and lower fever, while its therapeutic actions include antipyretic, anti-inflammatory, and analgesic properties. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
